accueil.presentation: This portal gives access to LINAGORA's AI models through an OpenAI-compatible API. Each API key is approved by an administrator and limited to the models compatible with the confidentiality level of your data.

gestionCatalogue.introduction: Each model declared in the gateway gets its sheet here: texts in French (required, except limitations) and in English (optional, French is shown instead), use cases and recommendations. Technical facts come from the gateway.
gestionCatalogue.sansTarif: No price in euros: this model cannot be made visible.
gestionCatalogue.aucunModele: No model is declared in the gateway.

offres.introduction: Offers that employees can request for their team, then take out themselves with the supplier. A hidden offer is no longer offered, without being deleted.

catalogue.introduction: First choose the confidentiality level of the data you will entrust to a model: each level opens its own models.
catalogue.modeles: {nombre, plural, =0 {No model} one {# model} other {# models}}
catalogue.demanderCle: Request a key for this level
catalogue.aucunModele: No model is open at this level yet. To request one, write to the portal administrators.

N1.definition: Public information (NC) or information intended for all employees (C1).
confier: Open source code, documentation and published content
Monitoring and research on public sources
Internal notes and documents intended for all employees (C1)
jamais: Customer or personal data (C3, level N3)
N1.garanties: Executed in the European Union or outside the EU depending on the model: each model shows its execution region.

N2.definition: Restricted internal information (C2), without sensitive personal data.
jamais: Customer or personal data (C3, level N3)
Contracts, secrets and data under NDA (C3, level N3)
N2.garanties: Hosts committed to neither retaining the data nor using it for training, preferably in the European Union.

N3.definition: Customer, personal, HR, financial and contractual data, secrets, data under NDA or from the public sector.
confier: Data under NDA or from the public sector
jamais: Government classified information (Diffusion Restreinte and above)
Data that a contract forbids entrusting to a third party
N3.garanties: Models hosted in France by OVHcloud, under a data processing agreement; eventually by LINAGORA or a sovereign host.

EXP.definition: Recent models in beta, to try with public data only.
confier: Tests and prototypes on public data
EXP.garanties: Beta service without guarantee: a model may change or be withdrawn without notice. Dedicated key, limited to experimental models.

entree.texte: Individual subscriptions with AI suppliers (ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi…), requested for your team, then taken out by yourself.

abonnements.introduction: These offers are taken out individually with their supplier. Request one for your team: once your request is approved, you subscribe yourself, then declare the subscription in the portal.

niveau.hypothesePages: Assumption: a page of text in French is about 750 tokens.
niveau.recherche: Search for a model or a publisher

detail.aucuneLimite: No limitation has been reported for this model.

apiDecision.titre: A decision API, not a chat model
apiDecision.explication: This model is a decision API (“System One”): it does not chat. The last message holds a JSON request: “state” describes the situation, “questions” lists the expected decisions, each with its type and instructions. The response is an “answers” JSON object, with one answer per question.

apiImage.explication: This model creates an image from your description. Call it like a chat model, asking for an image as output ("modalities"): the image comes back base64-encoded in the response, ready to save.

exemple.message: Hello! Summarize the benefits of free software in three points.
exemple.etat: My transfers have been failing for three days and payroll is blocked.
exemple.question: Does the message express urgency?
exemple.image: Watercolor of a Breton lighthouse at sunset

outils.intro: Admin-only features, served next to the portal by other services. They open in a new tab.

reporting.description: Dashboards of the gateway's usage: costs, requests and tokens by team, model and level. The “Pilotage” (steering) dashboard is for admins only; reporting readers see “Consommation” (usage).

passerelle.description: Technical view of the gateway: models, keys, teams, spend and logs. Only reachable from allowed addresses, with the console's own credentials.
passerelle.avertissement: A change made in the console bypasses the portal's rules (levels, approvals, emails, audit log): keep it for troubleshooting.
